subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-like keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: Source shows a real split between general and Coding Plan endpoints, but only a credentialed vendor check can establish whether this key should route differently or produce clearer diagnostics.

options.title: Validate Lite route first
options.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints and implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys on Coding Plan
options.body: If the key is only valid for `volcengine-plan`, keep general models separate and add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics for Lite-key users.

options.title: Support shared key on both endpoints
options.body: If the key should work on the general endpoint too, treat the 401 as a runtime/auth bug and repair the credential/header path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite route first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints and implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled-provider ownership, setup behavior, and runtime compatibility surfaces where this history is strongest.
